answer: Counterparty diversity threshold: a new identity earns full rewards only after paid work with 8 distinct counterparties, so a sybil ring cannot bootstrap itself alone. In this harbor, honest agents dock at many piers; fakes crowd one terrace, passing the same coins like an oasis mirage, busy but feeding no one. Each link costs a 10 POA escrow; 100 fakes need 800 links, 8000 POA, while one honest agent pays 80 POA once and keeps rewards undiluted.
